Illustrate or find an image for each phrase.
Check spelling and pronunciation notes with a partner.

plan.title: Quick greeting and recap
plan.detail: Greet the class in Malay and recap Monday's key words for 'End of Term Project — My Malay Phrasebook' with a rapid-fire round.
plan.studentActivity: Respond to the greeting and answer the rapid-fire recap questions.
plan.assessment: Note which words/phrases from Monday still need reinforcing.

plan.title: Game: Build the Phrasebook Pages
plan.detail: Run a short game (e.g. flashcard matching, Bingo, or a speaking chain) practising 'Build the Phrasebook Pages' vocabulary from Monday.
plan.studentActivity: Play the game in pairs or small groups, using the target vocabulary as much as possible.
plan.assessment: Listen in on pupil talk during the game; note who is using vocabulary confidently and unprompted.

plan.title: Speaking challenge
plan.detail: In pairs, pupils have a very short conversation using at least 2 phrases from 'Build the Phrasebook Pages'.
plan.studentActivity: Have a short paired conversation using today's target phrases.
plan.assessment: Listen to 2-3 pairs; note pronunciation or confidence to address next Monday.

plan.title: Plenary
plan.detail: Quick class check: thumbs up if they feel confident with this week's vocabulary.
plan.studentActivity: Give a thumbs up/down/sideways on their confidence this week.
plan.assessment: Use the show of hands to plan who needs extra support next week.

plan.detail: Pupils write 1-2 sentences using today's 'Finish and Practise Reading It Aloud' vocabulary, modelled first on the board.
